files.description: THE ORCHESTRATOR. run_full() calls every stage in order and returns one bundle; it resolves each stage module and data file by name (_find) so a missing file fails loudly instead of silently defaulting. Everything else in this table is reached from here.

Stage 0. Sample intake and chain of custody: IDAT arrival, manifest creation, identity checks. Built step by step against the SOP; four QC checks are still deferred because Stage 0 is not yet handed the raw intensities (open item, row 0).
Pure-Python IDAT to beta - needs only idat_parse plus a static array manifest, no methylprep or minfi at runtime. This is what lets a reader reproduce Stage 1 without the R/Bioconductor stack.
Low-level IDAT binary reader used by Stage 1 when methylprep is not driving the parse.
Stage 1. Raw Illumina IDAT pair -> beta per CpG (methylprep, noob background/dye correction). The only step that touches instrument output.
Stage 2. Constrained non-negative least squares: which cell types are present and in what fraction. Sparse by design - it reports only what it has evidence for.
Helper for Stage 2b: splits a lineage signal across its member entries.
Stage 2b. The second, independent solver (inverse-variance weighted, atlas posterior SD as the weight). Reported ONLY as an agreement flag at class level, never as the composition.
Stage 4.5. Splits a departure into its hyper- and hypo-methylated halves, so direction is reported rather than magnitude only.
Builds the CpG -> pixel mapping from the array manifest in genomic order. Deterministic: same atlas + manifest -> byte-identical output.
One-time generator for the mapping: lays the CpGs on the sphere in genomic order so every patient projection sits on the same grid as the archival plates.
Stage 4.6. The patient's sky: residual z per CpG against the sample's own composition expectation, on the laboratory's zero and scale, projected onto the sphere in genomic order.
Stage 5. The departure: distance from the healthy centre in units of healthy spread over the assessable class axes (Mahalanobis, 1936).
Stage 6. Inverts the healthy age curve. Reports the RESOLUTION, never an age in years: one array cannot place a person to better than ~50 yr (PROC-AGE-01).
THE ONLY tier function. Reads tier_breakpoints.json; the engine previously carried three disagreeing definitions. Returns no tier when a reading is not reportable, and AT_CEILING at 1/H_min.
The A-score itself: A = mean_i H(beta_i) / H_min(class). Asserts against the wrong aggregation (entropy of the mean beta), which is the defect PROC-N7-01 caught.
The class gauge: the eight frozen H_min floors and the per-substrate table. Holds the saturation ceilings (1/H_min).
The laboratory zero: median of 40 healthy arrays of that laboratory, age-referenced. Refuses panels under 40 and marks a reading without a zero as NOT REPORTABLE.
What the per-class archives contain and how to unpack them.
Packages the rebuild outputs into the repo-ready atlas (.csv.xz) and the per-class archives.
Per-class atlas rebuild archive (cycling).
The atlas build: a hierarchical Beta-Binomial MCMC run per architecture class, producing the posterior mean, SD and interval for every CpG-by-cell-type entry.
Per-class atlas rebuild archive (immune).
Per-class atlas rebuild archive (progenitor).
Per-class atlas rebuild archive (secretory).
Per-class atlas rebuild archive (adult stem).
Per-class atlas rebuild archive (pluripotent stem) - the raw MCMC output the merged atlas was assembled from.
Per-class atlas rebuild archive (stromal).
Per-class atlas rebuild archive (terminal).
The leave-one-out bootstrap cross-check of the floors. Its function was rerun on the eight methylation floors in September (PROC-HMIN-BOOT-01); every frozen floor fell inside its interval.
CHAIN E(a_bio): an activation-function fit to published age-stratified pace-of-ageing data. Pre-atlas; record-side.
CHAIN G-002: the MCMC that calibrated the eight methylation H_min floors against 37 published reference cell methylomes. This is the provenance of every floor on the report.
CHAIN G-003b: H_min posteriors for the four non-methylation substrates (nucleosome occupancy, fuzziness, windowed protection, fragment size).
CHAIN G-008: a zero-free-parameter prediction of the tumour-versus-normal A-score gap. Pre-atlas surface; part of the record, not a result of this chain.
CHAIN n_bio: tests whether the class ordering is consistent with published respirometry. Pre-atlas; record-side.
Published reference A-score anchors per class (healthy / disease / cancer), extracted from the April web build. Orientation values from the literature, not measurements of this chain.
The result of that bootstrap: per class, the frozen floor beside its bootstrap interval.

THE ATLAS. 483,092 CpGs x 115 cell types, each entry a posterior mean with an SD and credible interval from the MCMC build. Every comparison on the report is against this file. Ships compressed (.xz); decompress once.
The atlas as shipped (compressed). Decompress with Python's lzma - no system xz needed.
Which of the 8 architecture classes each of the 115 cell types belongs to. The bridge between per-cell and per-class reporting.
How the atlas was built: sources, sample counts, MCMC settings, checksums.
Which atlas cell types are collinear - i.e. which ones the reference cannot fully separate. Directly relevant to per-cell reporting: entries inside one group should not be scored against each other.
The directional panel: per-CpG healthy mean and direction. Only the immune class has a sealed panel today.
The Illumina array manifest (IlmnID, CHR, MAPINFO). Supplies the genomic coordinates the sky projection and the locality measurement need.
The EPIC v1 B4 array manifest (alternative to the combined manifest).
What the mapping is, how it was generated, and its determinism guarantee.
Where the array manifests came from and how they were normalised.
The mapping array itself (the .npz is the packaged form). 483,092 CpGs to 196,608 pixels in genomic order.
The mapping itself: 483,092 CpGs onto 196,608 pixels. Measured 2026-09-22 to be genomically local - every pixel holds contiguous CpGs of one chromosome, median span 511 bp.
Provenance and checksum of the mapping.
The measured healthy presence floor per class: below it a class IS NOT THERE in this specimen, so its panel is masked rather than scored.

The April age table in CSV form (same typed content as the JSON).
The April 80-cell age table. Typed beta means with A by formula - NOT a per-sample measurement; kept because parts of the record cite it. The live age term comes from reference_age_curve_v1.json.
The tier boundaries, the Warburg line (1.07) and the breach line (1.10), plus the reference clusters. The single source for every tier word on the report.
The ~100 discriminative marker CpGs per cell type, used for the per-cell separation statistic. The sealed foundation-cohort anchors reproduce on THIS file, so it cannot be changed without a re-seal.

How exclusive each entry's marker panel is to that entry (measured 2026-09-22). 33.8 % of markers serve more than one panel; the report withholds the individual per-cell claim for the 36 entries under 25 % exclusivity.
Per-entry healthy reference: for each of the 115 entries, the healthy range of its own per-cell reading, per laboratory. Exploration, unsealed.
Earlier single-file gauge; cpg_gauge_engine.py plus cpg_tiers.py do this now.
THE IDENTITY LOCI and the eight class floors. The unimodal addresses where a healthy class sits at one level - the surface the reported gauge reads (row B). H_min per class lives here.
The provisional band before the four-laboratory zeros. identity_band_v3.json is live.
The commissioned healthy band, pooled and per decade, with each laboratory's measured zero. Placement (IN_BAND / above / below) is read from here.
The healthy age curve: about +0.47 milli-A per year, built leave-one-laboratory-out from four cohorts (n=1,379). The decade term is subtracted before a sample is placed.
